easyPrerequisites: You have an additional {2}{W}{W} available or control a nontoken white creature that can be sacrificed
description:
Cast Flare of Fortitude by paying {2}{W}{W} or by sacrificing a nontoken white creature, causing your life total to be unable to change until end of turn.
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing no life due to Flare of Fortitude
Repeat the process in step 2 as many times as desired.
